observations.quote: Workflow software for teams that ship

issues.title: Navigation links use abstract icons and lack descriptive labels
issues.description: The navigation bar uses abstract Unicode symbols (such as ☖, ▤, ◯, ✉) instead of text labels, and contains links that lack accessible names, causing screen readers to read generic identifiers like 's0e2' or '☖'.
issues.recommendation: Replace the Unicode symbols with descriptive text labels (e.g., 'Home', 'Features', 'Pricing', 'Contact') and ensure all navigation links have appropriate aria-labels.

issues.title: Persistent 'Before you go' interstitial traps user in a loop during signup
issues.description: Users attempting to proceed through the registration/signup flow are repeatedly presented with a 'Before you go' screen across multiple steps, creating an unavoidable roadblock.
issues.recommendation: Refactor the onboarding flow to remove or allow easily dismissing the 'Before you go' prompt, ensuring users can proceed directly to starting their trial.

issues.title: Email input field lacks an associated accessible label
issues.description: The email input field on the trial signup page relies solely on a placeholder and lacks a programmatically associated label, which prevents screen readers from announcing it clearly.
issues.recommendation: Add a visible label element with a 'for' attribute matching the input's 'id', or add an 'aria-label' attribute to the input element.

events.description: The main navigation links use non-descriptive icon characters ('☖', '▤', '◯', '✉') instead of clear text labels, making them inaccessible without context.
The page is focused entirely on lead generation via a free trial, with no visibility into actual service pricing or contract terms.
